upstream_source.mapping: MAPPED: reject a damaged restorable archive before writing any home member, and return a nonzero outcome on an incomplete restore. The upstream CLI reference delta is represented in the integration website reference.
MAPPED: catch member read errors consistently and preflight only what restore can write, excluding runtime files and archived SQLite sidecars.

final_observable_contract: After confirmation but before the first restore write, hermes import streams each restorable ZIP member to EOF and checks its integrity. A damaged member refuses the entire import, preserves the current home, and returns 1 through the CLI. Deliberately skipped runtime files and foreign SQLite sidecars do not block a usable archive, while external provider members are not misclassified by their basename. A member read failure after preflight is reported as an incomplete import and returns 1.
